contentSections.title: Pre-eclampsia
contentSections.content:
Pre-eclampsia is a pregnancy complication that can seriously affect mum's health and the baby's growth, if not treated early.

This condition develops due to high blood pressure, where blood vessels narrow and the blood flow through to vital organs (e.g. brain, kidneys, and liver) becomes more difficult. Pre-eclampsia can be detected through regular checkups during pregnancy.
